title: paeonia × suffruticosa subsp. spontanea
intro: Paeonia × suffruticosa subsp. spontanea, commonly known as Chinese peony, is a perennial plant native to China and is known for its vibrant flowers and medicinal properties. The health benefits of Chinese peony include its use as a natural remedy for anxiety, insomnia, and menstrual disorders due to its anti-inflammatory and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Chinese peony include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce muscle spasms, and alleviate menstrual cramps. The bioactive constituents of Chinese peony include alkaloids, glycosides, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
